"rationale": "A PTAT core sets I0 = UT*ln16/R1, about 0.35 uA per branch. A mirrored output current I2 feeds R2 to PNP Q3, with R4 to ground, so Vref = R4/(R2+R4)*(Veb3 + I2*R2) ≈ 0.55*1.2 V = 0.66 V. Total current is about 1.2 uA, roughly 2.2 uW. The core devices run in deep weak inversion, which saves headroom. They use long channels (L of about 10 um) for high VA, which sets PSRR and line regulation. A resistor/NMOS start-up circuit pulls pg low in the zero-current state."}

PARAMS = {
    "I0":     (0.35e-6, 0.15e-6, 0.6e-6),   # core branch current (PTAT)
    "k2":     (1.4, 0.8, 2.5),              # output-branch current ratio I2/I0
    "Xbg":    (1.20, 1.05, 1.35),           # internal 'full bandgap' Veb3+I2*R2 (TC knob)
    "gmid_n": (22.0, 15.0, 26.0),           # NMOS level-shift pair (deep weak inversion)
    "gmid_p": (14.0, 10.0, 16.0),           # PMOS mirror
    "Lk":     (5.0, 2.0, 8.0),              # channel-length multiplier on L=2 um base (VA boost)
    "Cpg":    (2e-12, 0.2e-12, 5e-12),      # pg-to-vdd cap (PSRR / mirror gate tracks vdd)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VREF = 0.66
    N, m1, m3 = 16, 2, 8
    I0 = p["I0"]; I2 = p["k2"] * I0; X = p["Xbg"]; k = p["Lk"]
    Lb = 2.0

    def veb(I, m):
        return 0.76 + UT * math.log(I / (10e-6 * m))

    # PTAT core resistor
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I0

    # Solve the fractional-bandgap output branch
    I3 = 0.07e-6
    for _ in range(60):
        v3 = veb(I3, m3)
        R2 = max((X - v3) / I2, 1e3)
        I3 = max((VREF - v3) / R2, 1e-9)
        I3 = min(I3, 0.9 * I2)
    v3 = veb(I3, m3)
    R2 = max((X - v3) / I2, 1e3)
    R4 = VREF / max(I2 - I3, 1e-9)
    a = R4 / (R2 + R4)
    vref_pred = a * (v3 + I2 * R2)

    # Device sizing at L=2 base, then scale W and L by k
    # (weak inversion: same W/L keeps Id, VA scales ~k)
    mn  = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], Lb, I0, vds=0.4, vsb=0.65)
    mp  = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lb, I0, vds=0.6)
    mp7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lb, I2, vds=1.0)
    Wn, Wp, Wp7, L = mn.W * k, mp.W * k, mp7.W * k, Lb * k

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PTAT core
    n.M("M3", "n1", "n1", "e1", "vss", "nfet", Wn, L)       # diode level shifter
    n.M("M4", "pg", "n1", "r1t", "vss", "nfet", Wn, L)      # forces r1t = e1
    n.M("M5", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, L)      # PMOS diode
    n.M("M6", "n1", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, L)      # mirror into M3 branch
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=m1)
    n.R("R1", "r1t", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=m1 * N)
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", p["Cpg"])
    # Output (fractional bandgap) branch
    n.M("M7", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp7, L)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=m3)
    n.R("R4", "vref", "vss", R4)
    # Start-up: s high when core off -> Ms1 pulls pg low; n1 rises -> Ms3 kills s
    n.R("Rsu", "vdd", "s", 1e9)
    n.C("Csu", "vdd", "s", 20e-15)
    n.M("Ms1", "pg", "s", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms3", "s", "n1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 2.0)

    # Predictions
    T = 300.15
    dveb = (v3 - 1.22) / T
    slope = a * (dveb + I2 * R2 / T)
    tc = abs(slope) / vref_pred * 1e6 + 60.0
    dn = (mn.gds / mn.Id) / k
    dp = (mp.gds / mp.Id) / k
    dp7 = (mp7.gds / mp7.Id) / k
    nsl = 1.3
    S = ((1 + nsl) * dp + nsl * dn) / math.log(N) + dp7   # relative dI/dVdd
    lr = a * I2 * R2 * S                                   # V/V
    power = 1.8 * (2 * I0 + I2 + 2e-9)
    return n, {
        "vref": vref_pred,
        "tc_ppm": tc,
        "line_reg": lr * 1e3,
        "power": power,
        "psrr_1k": -20 * math.log10(max(lr, 1e-6)),
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
